title: Perfpal metrics.json schema v1.3
description: Versioned, LLM-agnostic output of a Perfpal static scan (languages: C, Rust, Python). All findings are OPTIMIZATION CANDIDATES, never certainties. Consumers MUST tolerate unknown rule_ids gracefully; breaking changes bump the major version.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this document. MAJOR.MINOR: minor = additive-only changes; major = breaking.

version.description: Semver of the perfpal binary that produced this report.

root_path.description: Scanned repository root as given to the CLI.

languages.description: Languages scanned — the sorted-unique set of files[].language (or the supported set ["c","python","rust"] on a zero-file scan); widening is a minor-bump schema re-emission.

parse_health_summary.description: Aggregate parse quality. Findings inside failed/error regions are suppressed or downgraded (confidence cap MEDIUM).

files.description: One record per scanned file (baseline stats, pillar 1a). No severity/confidence here by design.

language.description: Scanned file language (schema 1.3 admits c, rust, and python); widening is a minor-bump schema re-emission.

error_regions.description: Unparseable regions; reported, never analyzed as fiction.

resolver.description: Semantic-resolver outcome for this file (ADDITIVE v1.1; optional — omitted by producers without resolver support, so v1.0-style documents validate unchanged). absent = resolver disabled/unavailable; ok = libclang parsed the translation unit; failed = libclang reported a TU-level failure. Never deletes or degrades syntactic results.

stats.description: Baseline measurements (catalog §2) — always emitted, never findings.

distributions.description: Histograms over function-level stats (e.g. bucket '1-10' / metric 'length_lines').

metric.description: Function stat field name being distributed.

findings.description: Heuristic detections. Every finding is an optimization candidate with mandatory confidence and severity.

graphs.description: Architecture-level structure feeding pillar-1b visualization and ARCH-* findings.

to.description: null when unresolvable — a finding (ARCH-001), not a failure.

call_graph.description: Cross-file call edges only (intra-file edges omitted in v1). Name-based matching ⇒ edge confidence LOW until a semantic resolver exists.

to_path.description: Best-match file or null when unresolved.

confidence.description: ADDITIVE v1.1 widening from v1.0's const "LOW": name-based matching is LOW until the semantic resolver upgrades unambiguous edges (ADR-0001); v1.0 documents (all-LOW) still validate unchanged.

components.description: Hot-component aggregation (PERF-C-ARCH-002): directories/components ranked by aggregated metrics. Pure aggregation — no independent detection.

span.description: 1-based lines and 1-based byte columns (IR convention, docs/architecture/ir-v1.md §2). end_line/end_col are INCLUSIVE — they point at the last byte of the match.

confidence.description: Catalog confidence model. Downgrades: macro origin or ERROR-node overlap caps at MEDIUM; cross-file name-based edges are LOW until a semantic resolver exists.

severity.description: Prioritization hint, never a certainty claim. hot = likely dominant impact, review first; warn = measurable impact, schedule; info = context signal feeding aggregation.

resolver_tier.description: Resolver tier that served this record (ADR-0001). MVP emits syntactic only.

threshold.description: Configurable threshold that fired, for reproducibility (e.g. LOOP-001 min_nesting_depth=3, CALL-002 min_complexity=15).

allOf.description: Macro origin caps confidence at MEDIUM (catalog §1 downgrade rules).
Parse-error overlap caps confidence at MEDIUM (C11/C17 grammar-gap monitor).

finding_id.description: Deterministic composite: rule_id:path:start_line:start_col (column disambiguates two findings on one line). Parse by splitting from the RIGHT — paths may legally contain colons. Stable within one report for consumer dedupe.

rule_id.description: Stable heuristic ID from docs/heuristics/catalog-v1.md. v1 catalog IDs (15 Tier-1 + 8 Tier-2): PERF-C-ALLOC-001, PERF-C-ALLOC-002, PERF-C-ALLOC-003, PERF-C-STR-001, PERF-C-STR-002, PERF-C-STR-003, PERF-C-LOOP-001, PERF-C-LOOP-002, PERF-C-LOOP-003, PERF-C-LOOP-004, PERF-C-LOOP-005, PERF-C-LOOP-006, PERF-C-LOOP-007, PERF-C-LOOP-008, PERF-C-CALL-001, PERF-C-CALL-002, PERF-C-ARCH-001, PERF-C-ARCH-002, PERF-C-ARCH-003, PERF-C-TYPE-001, PERF-C-TYPE-002, PERF-C-MEM-001, PERF-C-MEM-002. Pattern-based (not a closed enum) so new heuristics/languages arrive as minor bumps without breaking strict v1.x validation; consumers must ignore unknown rule_ids.

title.description: Human-readable heuristic name from the catalog.

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the matched location.

macro_suspect.description: True when any part of the matched span originates from a macro expansion; implies confidence ≤ MEDIUM.

error_node_overlap.description: True when the span intersects a parse-error region; implies confidence ≤ MEDIUM.

message.description: Human/LLM-readable explanation framed as optimization candidate, never certainty.

evidence.description: Rule-specific machine-readable facts that triggered the finding (e.g. callee names, measured depth, co-occurring rule_ids). Keys vary per rule_id.
